frequency_question: How often does structural friction prevent the implementation of a countercyclical capital buffer when the central bank seeks to raise it?
membership_rule: Major central banks or financial stability authorities operating under Basel III frameworks that have formally proposed or deliberated setting a positive CCyB rate.

cases.name: Bank of England CCyB second activation
Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB activation
Federal Reserve Board CCyB calibration review

coverage_note: 7 major documented implementations across G10 economies; comprehensive of primary adopters.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with less standardized institutional frameworks.
skeleton: Jurisdictions implementing Basel III macroprudential buffers across G20 and advanced economies where banking sector resilience goals align with activation mandates.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 major jurisdictions attempting initial non-zero implementation phases gives ~86%
validity_reason: Basel III structural implementation standards remain stable across this horizon.
